description: Save a session's workbook to disk. Without `path`, or with the session's own file, it is a Save back to that file. Any other `path` is a Save As: a sandbox session then belongs to the new file; an attended session writes a copy and stays on its own file. The file extension picks the format — prefer `.sxl` for working copies and pipelines, `.xlsx` when Excel itself will open the file. Relative paths resolve against the workspace. A Save As refuses to replace an existing file unless `overwrite` is true.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file on a Save As. Saving to the session's own file never needs it.

path.description: Destination file path, e.g. "CFI P&L (agent).sxl". Omit to save back to the session's own file.

session_id.description: Target session id, from `info` or `list_sessions`. Required.

name: session_save
